title: Nvidia Unveils $500B AI Chip Deal with OpenAI
description: Nvidia announced a $500 billion AI chip partnership with OpenAI.
body: Nvidia has announced the largest AI chip deal in history. The $500 billion partnership with OpenAI will span five years and cover next-generation GPU development. This deal reshapes the AI infrastructure landscape.

title: Google DeepMind Announces Gemini 3 Breakthrough
description: Google DeepMind revealed Gemini 3 with unprecedented reasoning capabilities.
body: Google DeepMind's Gemini 3 model achieves state-of-the-art results across all benchmarks. The breakthrough in reasoning capabilities marks a significant step toward AGI.

title: Anthropic Raises $10B for Claude Development
description: Anthropic secured $10 billion in funding for Claude AI.
body: Anthropic closed a massive $10 billion funding round. The investment will accelerate Claude's development and expand enterprise features.

title: Microsoft Layoffs 15,000 Employees in Reorganization
description: Microsoft laid off 15,000 employees as part of AI reorganization.
body: Microsoft announced the layoff of 15,000 employees. The reorganization focuses on AI-first strategy and consolidates multiple divisions.

title: EU Proposes New AI Regulation Framework
description: European Union unveils comprehensive AI regulation.
body: The EU has proposed a new framework for AI regulation. The rules target high-risk AI applications and require transparency from developers.

title: Meta Releases Open Source LLM Benchmark
description: Meta published a new benchmark for open source LLMs.
body: Meta's new benchmark evaluates open source LLMs across multiple dimensions. The results show rapid improvement in open source model quality.

title: Startup Raises £800M for AI Drug Discovery
description: AI drug discovery startup closed $800 million funding.
body: A London-based AI startup raised £800 million for drug discovery using machine learning. The round was led by top venture capital firms.

title: Tesla Autopilot Lawsuit: $50M Settlement Reached
description: Tesla settled autopilot lawsuit for $50 million.
body: Tesla reached a $50 million settlement in the autopilot lawsuit. The case involved a fatal accident where the system failed to detect obstacles.

title: Samsung Developing AI Memory Chips with HBM4E
description: Samsung's next-gen AI memory chips in development.
body: Samsung is developing HBM4E memory chips optimized for AI workloads. The new memory promises 2x bandwidth improvement over current generation.

title: Hugging Face Launches New Dataset Platform
description: Hugging Face released a new dataset management platform.
body: Hugging Face announced a new platform for dataset management. The platform includes version control, collaboration features, and integration with existing ML pipelines.

title: SEC Probes AI Fraud Startup Claims
description: SEC investigating AI startup for fraudulent claims.
body: The SEC has launched an investigation into an AI startup accused of fraud. The company allegedly misrepresented its AI capabilities to investors.

title: Oracle Reports $5B AI Cloud Revenue Growth
description: Oracle AI cloud revenue grew by $5 billion.
body: Oracle reported $5 billion in AI cloud revenue for the quarter. The growth is driven by enterprise AI adoption and database optimization.

title: Apple Acquires AI Vision Startup for $200M
description: Apple acquired an AI vision startup.
body: Apple acquired a computer vision startup for $200 million. The technology will enhance AR/VR capabilities in future products.

title: Adobe Integrates Firefly into Creative Suite
description: Adobe Firefly now integrated across Creative Cloud.
body: Adobe announced full integration of Firefly AI across its Creative Suite. Users can now generate images, edit videos, and design layouts using natural language.

title: Mistral AI Releases New Language Model
description: Mistral AI launched a new language model.
body: Mistral AI released its latest language model with improved efficiency. The model outperforms larger alternatives on key benchmarks.

title: India's UPI Crosses 10B Monthly Transactions with AI
description: India's UPI payment system processed 10 billion monthly transactions using AI fraud detection.
body: India's UPI payment system crossed 10 billion monthly transactions. AI-powered fraud detection has been key to scaling the system securely.

title: California Sues Gas Stations for AI Price Fixing
description: California filed lawsuit against gas stations using AI for price fixing.
body: California has filed a lawsuit against major gas station chains for using AI algorithms to fix prices. The complaint alleges collusion through shared pricing software.

title: SpaceX Valuation Tops Amazon at $1.2T
description: SpaceX market cap reached $1.2 trillion, surpassing Amazon.
body: SpaceX valuation has surged to $1.2 trillion, surpassing Amazon's market cap. The growth is driven by Starlink revenue and Starship contracts.

title: Harvard Study: AI Coding Assistants Reduce Bugs by 40%
description: Harvard study found AI coding tools reduce software bugs.
body: A Harvard study found that AI coding assistants reduce software bugs by 40%. The research tracked 10,000 developers over six months.

title: SoftBank CEO Predicts AGI by 2030
description: Masayoshi Son predicts AGI arrival by 2030.
body: SoftBank CEO Masayoshi Son predicts Artificial General Intelligence will arrive by 2030. He announced increased investment in AI infrastructure.
